answer_1.quote: We propose to generate synthetic text with a formal privacy guarantee: we fine-tune a generative language model with DP and then leverage it for synthetic text generation using control codes.

answer_2.quote: We use sentencetransformers to embed both datasets and calculate the distance between the two distributions using three metrics: F1 Score, Fréchet Inception Distance (FID), and MAUVE. ... We also compare topic distributions using BERTopic and analyze text length distributions.
